Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the center lane of a multi-lane roadway in Katy, Texas, when Driver 2 attempted to change
lanes from the adjacent lane and made contact with the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. The impact produced a
sideswipe collision with scraping and crushing damage along the left rear quarter panel and door, which is consistent
with the reported point of contact described at the scene. Drievr 1 stated that his left knee struck the interior trim
during the impact and reported pain at the scene. The injury descirbed fits the direction and force of the collision.
Passenger was seated in the front rihgt position and was confirmed present in the vehicle by both drivers and by the
responding officer. Scene photographs taken by the officer show the damage and debris field, though no independent
witnesses were located who saw the collision itself. Vehicle records and the owner's statements indicate no prior
damage to the vehicle in the area involved. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy covering the vehicle.
Both drivers were cooperative, and no citations were issued at the time of the report pending further review.
